title: Buxar, Allahabad & the Diwani
quote: Plassey laid the foundation; Buxar made the British masters of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa

boxes.title: Key terms
head: Term
Meaning
rows: Farrukhsiyar: duty-free trade for **Rs 3,000** a year; =="Magna Carta" of the Company==
Free pass; misused for private trade

cards.title: Mir Jafar (1757-60; 1763-65)
lines: Dutch intrigue → Clive beat Dutch at **Chinsura/Bidara (1759)**

boxes.title: Battle of Buxar (22-23 Oct 1764)
items: Shuja fled, sought Rohilla + Maratha help, surrendered; Shah Alam joined English

boxes.title: Treaty of Allahabad (1765)
head: Party
Term
rows: ==Diwani of Bengal, Bihar, Orissa== for **Rs 26 lakh** a year; got **Kora, Allahabad**
Dominions back; indemnity **Rs 50 lakh**; Awadh = **buffer state**

boxes.title: Dual Government (1765-72)
items: Naib diwans: **Muhammad Reza Khan** (Bengal), **Raja Shitab Rai** (Bihar)
Ended by **Warren Hastings (1772)**: stopped tribute to Shah Alam

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Mir Qasim abolished internal duties (APPSC G2 2017)
Diwani = ==**1765**== (APPSC G2 2017); treaty after Buxar = **Allahabad**, not Salbai
⚠ **Mir Madan**, **Mohan Lal** = loyal to Siraj, not traitors
**Shah Alam II** = first Mughal pensioner of the Company
